method.current: union of frozen structure evidence boundaries and landmarks
method.deduplication: same baseline round(time,9), sorted unique times; matching uses unique locations
method.duplicates: exact equality after rounding to 9 decimals; no tolerance-based merging
method.meaning: Representability ceiling, not Drop detection performance; beatGrid all is descriptive density upper bound only; Stage 1 is label-aware development.
method.packet: Descriptive compact sorted UTF-8 JSON: retain other packet fields; remove boundaries/landmarks for interaction-only and beatGrid; append full source records as auditCandidateRecords. Unions retain current fields. No schema or provider request is changed.
method.tokens: ceil(compact UTF-8 bytes / 4), rough estimate only; not model tokenizer counts or billable usage
method.type: Current records use boundary/landmark; interaction records use type if present, otherwise source; beatGrid uses role. Distributions count all raw family records; current and beatGrid priority is not-applicable.
